title: fix(payment): add error.type attribute to error spans
author: bhuvan-somisetty
body:
# Changes

Fixes #3758

The Payment Service correctly sets span status to `ERROR` when payment processing fails — whether from the `paymentFailure` feature flag, an invalid card number, an unsupported card type, or an expired card — but neither `charge.js` nor `index.js` set the `error.type` attribute on those error spans.

`error.type` is a [required attribute in the OpenTelemetry Semantic Conventions](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/general/recording-errors/#recording-errors-on-spans) whenever `span.status_code` is `ERROR`. Without it, span metrics processors and collector connectors that derive error rate metrics from spans cannot group or filter by error category, and observability platforms like Grafana and Jaeger cannot differentiate between a payment declined due to an expired card, an unsupported card type, or the `paymentFailure` flag.

Added `span.setAttribute('error.type', err.name || 'Error')` in the catch block of `charge.js` (which runs with the `charge` child span) and the catch block of `index.js` (which runs with the gRPC server span). Using `err.name` gives the standard JavaScript error class name (`'Error'` for generic `new Error(...)` throws) and falls back to `'Error'` if not set, keeping the value consistent and non-null.

Tested by running `node --check` on both files and manually verifying that the attribute value matches the thrown error's `name` property for each of the four failure paths in `charge.js`.

## Merge Requirements

This is a bug fix rather than a new feature, so most of this doesn't apply, but going through it:

* [x] `CHANGELOG.md` updated to document the fix
* [ ] Appropriate documentation updates in the docs (not applicable, this only adds a missing telemetry attribute on existing error spans)
* [ ] Appropriate Helm chart updates (not applicable, no config surface changed)
